newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.07 rupees up at 40.78 to the dollar on Monday in the kerb market amid a rise in supply of the U.S. currency from abroad, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to stabilise around current levels as dollar demand was on the rise.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 10 percent, compared to the last closing at 10.20 percent.
